meanings.note: Prefix 'под-' ('under, up to') indicates approaching or supporting from below (stem 'ождать'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'wait', paired with 'ждать'.

порадоваться.gloss: to rejoice, to be happy, to be glad

meanings.note: Prefix 'по-' forms perfective verbs or marks a brief/onset action (stem 'радоваться'). Reflexive/intransitive verb with the postfix '-ся'/'-сь' (historically from the reflexive pronoun 'себя', oneself). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to rejoice, to be happy, to be glad', paired with 'радоваться'.

examples.trans: So she would be happy for you!

examples.text: Чтобы она за тебя порадовалась! И меня простила.
examples.trans: So she'd be happy for you! And forgive me.
